description: Internal header for Type-C (USB-C) subsystem, defining enums, structures, and function prototypes for managing Type-C states, flags, timers, and power delivery features within the Zephyr OS USB-C subsystem.

methods.name: tc_set_state
methods.description: Sets the current Type-C state for the device.

methods.name: tc_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current Type-C state for the device.

methods.name: tc_pd_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables Power Delivery on the device.

methods.name: tc_subsys_init
methods.description: Initializes the Type-C subsystem; should only be called during subsystem init.

methods.name: tc_run
methods.description: Runs the Type-C layer state machine, typically called from port stack thread.

methods.name: tc_is_in_attached_state
methods.description: Checks if the device's Type-C layer is in an attached state.

methods.name: tc_select_src_collision_rp
methods.description: Sets the Collision Avoidance Rp value for source collision detection.
